reviews.title: Muslim
reviews.text:
The app itself is good and useful, but unfortunately, things have changed recently. The ads have become longer and more intrusive, and even worse, dating apps and ads containing inappropriate or sexually suggestive content have started appearing.

This is completely unacceptable in a Quran app. The developers need to decide what their priority is: maximizing profits through any kind of advertising, or respecting the sanctity of the Quran and their responsibility before Allah.

There is nothing wrong with earning revenue from the app, but the advertisements must be carefully selected and appropriate for an Islamic and Quranic application.

I sincerely hope the developers reconsider their advertising policy immediately and block all inappropriate content. We should not open an app to read the Quran only to be confronted with content that directly contradicts its values.

reviews.title: In appropriate ads
reviews.text:
I have been using this app for a long time, and I’m genuinely disappointed.

I understand that apps need revenue and that many encourage users to subscribe to a premium version to remove ads. However, for a Quran application, there should be stricter moderation of the advertisements being displayed.

It was very upsetting to open the app and see a vulgar advertisement displayed directly below the Quran, Azkar, and other Islamic content. Regardless of the advertising network being used, the app developers have a responsibility to ensure that inappropriate ads are filtered out in an application dedicated to the Quran.

I sincerely request that you implement stricter ad controls or review your ad providers so that content shown within the app remains respectful and appropriate for its purpose.

reviews.title: Ads with non Islamic content
reviews.text:
It is deeply concerning that a digital application designed for reading the Holy Quran displays inappropriate and non-Islamic advertisements, especially images featuring immodestly dressed women, in its unpaid version. Such content is completely against the sanctity, respect, and spiritual purpose of the Quran.

Developers and responsible authorities should take this matter seriously and implement strict ad controls to ensure that all advertisements shown within Islamic apps are respectful, modest, and appropriate. At the very least, inappropriate and immodest ads should be completely removed to preserve the dignity and religious sensitivity of users.

Islamic applications must remain aligned with Islamic values and provide a respectful, distraction-free environment for worship and recitation.
